title: Multiple Choice - Opposite in Meaning
description: Choose the word or phrase OPPOSITE in meaning to the underlined part.

questions.text: Consumers should avoid purchasing products that are not [eco-friendly] when shopping for household goods.
The chemical spill left the drinking reservoir completely [contaminated], forcing the city to shut off the water mains.
The campus coffee shop stopped handing out [single-use] plastic cups to customers.
Investing in clean geothermal energy is a [sustainable] solution that will protect our environment for generations.
The international summit urges major industrial nations to [reduce] their annual greenhouse gas emissions.
